seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: SoS unofficial primary returns: Panetta 58.4%, Peter Coe Verbica (R) 20.5%, Sean Dougherty (D) 11.5%, with the other candidates further back. Re-checked Hannah James: Ballotpedia's Panetta page lists her as a Democratic candidate in the June 2 primary, together with Ana Luz Acevedo-Cabrera and Sean Dougherty. The SoS returns and Ballot Explained show only Panetta and Verbica advancing. The Ballotpedia district page's general-election list seems to carry over primary candidates. No source found shows James as a write-in, so she is treated as eliminated in the primary. Verbica: one profile gives his birthplace as San Jose (not a primary source). A Santa Cruz County candidate statement exists (votescount.santacruzcountyca.gov/Portals/16/jun26/Statement-Verbica.pdf) but was not read. Vote Smart's Panetta prosecutor dates (Alameda 1996-2010) may combine county and federal roles; one profile calls him a federal prosecutor. Ballot designations not found.
